integrity: The finite face enumeration, complete acyclic matching and 384-action character evaluations have a reproducible standalone standard-library verifier; this does not imply independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the natural rational third-homology representation of the four-cube independence complex is classified. The integral equivariant lattice and higher-dimensional analogues are not claimed. External independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: The full hyperoctahedral homology representation of the four-cube independence complex
